overview_description.description:
Clutch serves as a customer marketing platform for business-to-consumer brands. It provides traditional marketing CRM, loyalty, gift card, mobile, email, and direct mail solutions.

The company was created to help businesses succeed in an evolving marketing landscape. Since 2012, they have continued to grow their platform into an innovative, data-centric marketing solution with one focus that empowering brands with the best technology so that they can identify, understand and motivate their customers.

about_short_description.short_description: Clutch serves as a customer marketing platform for business-to-consumer brands.

product.name: Clutch Platform
product.description: An AI-powered customer loyalty platform that centralizes consumer data, automates segmentation, and delivers individualized marketing interactions in real time.

product.name: Customer Data Platform (CDP)
product.description: A system that unifies customer data from multiple sources to create comprehensive profiles and enable AI-driven segmentation and analytics.

product.name: Loyalty Management
product.description: A loyalty program management tool that uses machine learning to create personalized customer journeys and optimize program performance.

product.name: Gift Cards & Stored Value
product.description: A solution for managing gift card issuance, redemption, and stored value accounts across multiple channels and locations.

product.name: Offer Management
product.description: A tool that deploys machine learning-driven personalized offers to customers based on behavior and segmentation.

product.name: Marketing Orchestration
product.description: A platform module that automates and optimizes marketing campaigns across multiple channels using AI and machine learning.
